The docs also have a dedicated 'Build with LLMs/AI' section, markdown (.md) page variants, and a hosted docs MCP server that agents like Cursor can query. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents actually using these docs effectively, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
